A.notes: A has one coherent idea: an editorial kiln ledger that keeps buying quick while making the cup variation and firing process feel specific. The scroll frames show meaningful motion in the firing diagram and some product variation, and the reduced-motion version keeps all content visible. It is less surprising than B, but it is more complete and more reliable across desktop and mobile.

B.notes: B has the stronger headline concept and a more distinctive art direction; the hero type and cup illustration feel tailored to the brief. But the page and mobile captures show large blank areas where product and shipping content should be, which materially hurts craft and trust for an e-commerce page. In the scroll frames, motion reads as light section-state changes rather than a richer story sequence, so it does less work than the concept suggests.

raw.why: A is the more dependable retail page: it fulfills the brief cleanly on desktop and mobile, while B is more stylish but visibly less complete and polished.
